card.name: Points before an unwanted or avoided action
card.fires_on: Scattered words and marks right before something unwanted, avoided or prohibited is stated, such as fearing, would, a period after an instruction, or boat in 'rock the boat'. Also fires on digits inside percentage tables.

modes.label: Avoidance wording
modes.description: Words about fearing, avoiding or not wanting something, just before the thing avoided is named.
modes.example: either<< fearing>> change or unwilling to take risks.

modes.label: Period after an instruction
modes.description: The full stop ending a short dosing or handling instruction, just before a 'do not' sentence or a warning.
modes.example: Swallow XELJANZ XR whole and intact<<.>> Do not crush, split, or chew

modes.label: Numbers in result tables
modes.description: Digits or decimal points inside percentages in a clinical data table.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like unwanted, unnecessary, attempt and excessive, and away from words about lacking or missing.
card.plain: It lights up where the text is about to name something to avoid or not do, plus some stray table digits.
